integrity: Analytical derivation for all lags; standalone exact-rational finite verification at lags one through twelve. Originality was assessed against named primary material and mathematical overlap searches but has not received independent assessment.
scientific_limitations: Exact result is restricted to the two specified diagonal sensors, positive integer lags, and Lebesgue initial data; it is not an estimate for all polygonal observables. Equivalence elsewhere in the broad spectral literature is a residual bibliographic risk.
title: Exact opposite-sign diagonal correlation laws for the area-preserving baker map
